limits: The repeat fixture starts from a clean library and explicitly imports a synthetic empty active record before editing the catalog. It does not cover catalog saving with no active record; that product path currently fails after saving when rendering settings.
Catalog primary-metric conversion uses the public compatibility API and legacy configuration renderer; this run does not claim that the old settings entry is reachable through current navigation.
These regression PDFs have automated pagination, completeness and cleanup checks. The separate sprint acceptance workflow owns full visual PDF review.

verificationLimits: All acceptance records are synthetic; browser contexts are isolated and offline.
Narrow screens use viewport emulation; physical devices and paper printing were not tested.
User sprint workbook was not materialized on Windows; cached Library values are not original-formula/chart verification.
Independent SciPy evidence verifies recorded calculation modules, not execution of the final standalone HTML.
No native Microsoft Excel, live AI-provider quality or clean Windows installation claim is made.
publicPathRedaction: Local candidate paths are replaced with a shared placeholder; exact identities remain in local evidence.
